intro: Choosing the right area matters more than the hotel itself in Sichon. Here are the main neighborhoods, who each suits, and where to book for your travel style.

blocks.html: Short answer: Sichon is a quiet coastal district north of Nakhon Si Thammarat. For beachfront resorts choose Hin Ngam Beach; for nicer sand and swimming pick Sichon Beach by the town; for quiet near the airport, Piti Beach to the north; and for local fishing life, Sichon town.

faq.q: Which Sichon beach should I stay at?
faq.a: For beachfront resorts and seaside eateries choose Hin Ngam; for nicer sand and swimming pick Sichon Beach just to the north; and Piti Beach further north is quiet and near Nakhon Si Thammarat Airport, good for a peaceful rest — pick by whether you want dining or quiet.

It suits travelers who want a quiet, local beach — Thais come for relaxed weekends, with a calm feel rather than the bustle of the famous islands, pretty sand, good-value resorts and fresh seafood, ideal for families and couples escaping the crowds.

faq.q: How are Sichon and Khanom different?
faq.a: Both are quiet Nakhon Si Thammarat coasts: Khanom is further north, known for pink dolphins and long beaches like Nadan and Nai Phlao, while Sichon is to the south with Hin Ngam, Sichon and Piti beaches and fishing villages. They are close, about 30–40 minutes apart by car, so you can combine them.
